labels.staff.ticket.password: I'm locked out. Again.|What was my password... Password2?|It says my account is locked!|I changed it on Friday and now it hates me.
labels.staff.ticket.printer_offline: The printer says OFFLINE.|Has anyone printed today? At all?|Printer's dead. I need these by ten.|Why does it say PC LOAD LETTER?
labels.staff.ticket.software_install: I need the new version installed.|Can IT put the spreadsheet thing on here?|It says I need an administrator.|Can I get the program everyone else has?
labels.staff.ticket.slow_pc: My PC is so slow.|It takes five minutes to open an email.|The little wheel just keeps spinning.|I could knit a jumper while this loads.
labels.staff.ticket.new_employee: Hi! First day. I don't have a login.|Where do I get an account?|They said IT would set me up?
labels.staff.ticket.network: Is the internet down for everyone?|Nothing loads on this floor!|The network's gone. Again.
labels.staff.ticket.elevator_fault: The lift stopped at every floor. Every one.|Is the lift possessed?|I could have walked. If we had stairs.
labels.staff.ticket.legacy_app: The case system crashed again.|Who still knows how the 1997 system works?|It's showing the green screen of doom.
labels.staff.ticket.build_server: The nightly build is red again.|Who broke the build?|Can't test anything, the build's broken.
labels.staff.ticket.pager_outage: My pager's gone quiet. That's never good.|Nobody on this floor is getting pages!|How do we know if someone needs us?
labels.staff.ticket.trading_terminal: My terminal froze mid-trade!|The market's moving and my screen isn't!|Every second this is frozen costs money.
labels.staff.thanks.player: Thanks!|You're a lifesaver.|Back in business.|Oh, that was quick.|Cheers, IT.
labels.staff.thanks.patch: Huh, it just fixed itself.|Thanks, PATCH. I think?|Did the robot do that?|Fixed before I finished complaining.
labels.staff.late: Still waiting on IT...|Did my ticket get lost?|Is anyone looking at this?|I'll just stare at the wall, then.
labels.staff.incident.wrong_target: Why did I get a password reset email?|That change was meant for someone else!
labels.staff.incident.overreach: Everything changed and nobody asked us.|Who did this to the whole floor?
labels.staff.incident.runaway_job: The printer won't stop printing!|We're drowning in test pages!
labels.staff.incident.wrong_command: It was working five minutes ago.|What did IT just do?
labels.staff.incident.dependency: The accounts package won't open now.|Something updated and now nothing works.
labels.staff.incident.permissions: I can install anything now. Is that... fine?|Why am I an administrator?
labels.staff.incident.bulk_misread: My ticket disappeared!|Where did all the tickets go?
labels.staff.incident.false_success: It says resolved. It is not resolved.|My ticket closed itself but I'm still stuck.
labels.staff.remember.wrong_target: Make sure it's MY account this time.
labels.staff.remember.overreach: Just my machine, please. Not the whole floor.
labels.staff.remember.wrong_command: Please don't let the robot touch it.
labels.staff.remember.dependency: Will this break the accounts package again?
labels.staff.remember.permissions: Am I still an administrator? Asking for a friend.
labels.staff.remember.bulk_misread: Is my ticket going to vanish again?
labels.staff.remember.false_success: Don't mark it done until it actually works.
labels.staff.manager_visit: We need to talk about all these tickets.|Management has some questions.|Have you got a minute? Several, actually.
